g.text: CLEAN SYSTEMS · PRODUCT THINKING · REALTIME WORKFLOWS
I build end-to-end products where architecture, security, business rules, and
user experience have to work together — not as separate features, but as one system.
Building Imminiq — a structured, contextual, collaborative learning platform.
Designing with clean architecture, queues, secure auth, and real-time systems.
Keeping the portfolio intentionally small: depth over noise.
• Structured roadmaps, lessons, and contextual AI support
• Progress tracking, activity insights, and public sharing
• Messaging, audio/video calls, and in-browser code execution
React · Vite · TypeScript · Express · MongoDB · Redis
Socket.IO · WebRTC · BullMQ · Piston · Turborepo · LLM APIs
First complete full-stack product. The project that taught me
how a transaction system fits together end to end.

Consistent, quiet work. Small commits, steady progress, honest iteration.
